import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

def make_cam(name, pos, look, up, fov_x=39.6):
    d=bpy.data.cameras.new(name); d.lens_unit='FOV'; d.angle=math.radians(fov_x)
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,d); bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(o)
    z=-Vector(look).normalized(); x=Vector(up).cross(z).normalized(); y=z.cross(x)
    from mathutils import Matrix
    R=Matrix(((x.x,y.x,z.x,0),(x.y,y.y,z.y,0),(x.z,y.z,z.z,0),(0,0,0,1)))
    o.matrix_world=Matrix.Translation(Vector(pos))@R
    return o
